searchText: I was reading about the committee sizes. The blogs I read say the committee size is at least 128. I previously thought it is exactly 128. Can someone confirm if it is =128 or >= 128? And I believe the required number of attestations for a block is >= 85. Correct? the protocol targets a committee size of 128 but they grow in size so that every validator is in exactly one committee each epoch, eg on mainnet committees are already larger than 128 blocks don’t require a certain number of attestations, but the more that attest to a block, the more weight that block has in the fork choice Thanks. 1. Where can I get to know the exact sizes of the committee and the public keys of the committee nodes? 2. When are validators kicked out and new validators added? you can get committee assignments from the beacon apis validators are shuffled into new committees each epoch Yes I understand that they are shuffled each epoch. But for the whole set of validators, how does a new validators make entry?
